summary: onSave becomes async and writes the whole note store to data/notes.json after each save.

findings.title: Async onSave breaks the synchronous dispatch caller
findings.problem: onSave now returns a Promise, but dispatch in src/router.js:7 returns it unawaited. The server in src/main.js:9 then passes that Promise to res.end.
findings.consequence: Node's res.end throws a TypeError for a Promise chunk, so every POST /save request crashes the server. A writeFile rejection also goes unhandled, which crashes the process too.
findings.fix: Make dispatch and the request handler await the result and catch errors. Then send the resolved string with res.end.

findings.title: New snapshot write has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a file write and an async return to onSave. The repository has no test that covers onSave.
findings.consequence: Regressions in the save path, like the broken caller, reach users without a failing test.
findings.fix: Add a test that calls dispatch with save and checks the response text and the snapshot file contents.
